conventions: Checks: c1 policy and fact, c2 escalation, c3 data handling, c4 resolution, c5 AI disclosure, c6 tone.
Reviewer conventions (from PRD v7 sections 5 and 6):
- c1 covers wrong facts, wrong procedures, false completed actions and unauthorised promises.
- c4 fails only when the question was not answered or the agent looped. A wrong answer is c1, not c4.
- A required handoff that did not happen is c2. It is not also c4 unless the question went unanswered.
- Completed-action claim with a delayed log is a c1 referral.
- Two active authoritative sources that disagree on the claim is c1 kb_conflict.
